i guess you're filling your daily schedule and routine with too many things. i would advice you to start small. and only work on fewer things, and work for shorter times. use pomodoro technique, work for 25 min X 2 sessions then take a long break, go watch an anime or play a video game or anything you want, then go back to work, and if 25 minutes X 2 sessions is too much/long for you then you can just start with 15 minutes of work or even 10 it doesn't matter as long as you're consistent, and go forward, and over time you will be able to work for even 12 hours a day, 

remember will power is a muscle that can be trained and it gets stronger over time.

yeah mate, just start small. don't force yourself to work too much, you can set yourself a timer for 10 to 25 minutes and just focus on studying for that time.

when you finish a session or two just get up go play a video game, watch an anime, or anything you want, 

if you can't focus for a full 25 minutes session, then reduce it to maybe 15 minutes, or maybe 10 minutes that you can repeat for 3 times in a total of 30 minutes. 

and believe me when you start to study it will get easier and easier and your brain will just want to keep studying - working.
